remarks: A stunningly renovated townhouse in the highly sought after Cranbury neighborhood of Norwalk, a stone's throw from the Wilton border. Upon entering the overall property, you'll feel as if you're on a special retreat with mature tree lined streets, flowers, pond, and perfectly manicured grounds that offer a private and serene setting every season of the year. The pool is set privately to the side with its own parking area and keyed entry. This home screams coastal luxury from the unique beachy-tone floors, to the seaside blue shiplap accent walls, and chic light fixtures throughout. The bathroom and shower floors add a sophisticated, modern feel that pairs well with the more humbled oceanic tones. Dramatic high ceilings, large windows, and skylights provide for an airy and bright feel. The fireplace and ceiling beams further enhance this modern, relaxing atmosphere. Open the sliding glass door to head out to your large balcony overlooking beautiful landscape and a babbling brook that leads to a small duck pond. New kitchen, bathrooms, and kitchen appliances. The master bedroom has a walk-in closet and stunning ensuite with double sinks, a shower bench, and makeup vanity. This unit has a large loft that can be used as an office, an extra living space, or for those home yoga sessions. The lower level can also be used as an additional office or workout space. Private entrance, large oversized attached garage and ample guest parking.
